title: Maximum number of maximal M-subspaces at fixed bent degree
summary: For each admissible fixed degree greater than two, determine the largest number of maximal M-subspaces a bent function can have and characterize all extremizers.

formal_statement.body: For every even $n$ and every degree $d$ with $3\le d\le n/2$, determine $\max\{|\mathcal{MS}_{n/2}(f)|:f\in\mathcal M,\deg(f)=d\}$ and characterize all degree-$d$ bent functions attaining this maximum.

scope.domain: Fixed-degree bent functions and their maximal M-subspaces
assumptions: f is a degree-d bent function in the source class M
scope.unresolved_remainder: The global extremum is understood for quadratic bent functions, but no exact maximum is known for every fixed degree d greater than two, and the extremizing functions are unclassified.

citations.label: Pasalic--Polujan--Kudin--Zhang, fixed-degree M-subspace maximum
citations.locator: Conclusion, first open question, journal p. 4477

progress.summary: The source asks for the exact fixed-degree maximum number of maximal M-subspaces and a classification of every extremizer.
